create_app.description: Create an app. It runs nothing, and costs nothing, until you deploy and scale it.
create_app.name: create_app

parameters.description: The app's name, 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or dashes. Heroku makes one up when this is blank.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Where the app runs. Default is United States.
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: The base image the app runs on. Default is Heroku's current default, heroku-24.
parameters.name: stack

delete_app.description: Delete an app, with its dynos, config vars and add-ons. This can't be undone.
delete_app.name: delete_app

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

get_account.description: Get the connected Heroku account: its email, name and default team.
get_account.name: get_account

get_app.description: Get an app's details: its web address, region, stack and maintenance mode.
get_app.name: get_app

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

get_config_vars.description: Get an app's config vars, each name with its value. Values are often secrets, and show in the run's history.
get_config_vars.name: get_config_vars

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

list_apps.description: List every app the account can reach, its own and its teams', by name.
list_apps.name: list_apps

list_builds.description: List an app's builds, newest first, with each one's status.
list_builds.name: list_builds

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: How many of the newest builds to return, from 1 to 1,000. Default is 200.
parameters.name: limit

list_dynos.description: List an app's running dynos, with each one's type, size and state.
list_dynos.name: list_dynos

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

list_process_types.description: List an app's process types (web, worker) with how many dynos of what size each runs.
list_process_types.name: list_process_types

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

list_releases.description: List an app's releases, newest first: deploys, config changes and rollbacks.
list_releases.name: list_releases

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: How many of the newest releases to return, from 1 to 1,000. Default is 200.
parameters.name: limit

restart_all_dynos.description: Restart every dyno of an app.
restart_all_dynos.name: restart_all_dynos

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

restart_dyno.description: Restart one dyno of an app, such as web.1.
restart_dyno.name: restart_dyno

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: The dyno to restart, by name (web.1) or ID.
parameters.name: dyno

rollback_release.description: Roll an app back to an earlier release's code and config vars, as a new release.
rollback_release.name: rollback_release

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: The release to roll back to: its ID, or its version such as v12.
parameters.name: release

rollback_release.result_str_template: Roll back to a release completed.

scale_process_type.description: Change how many dynos a process type runs, or their size. More or larger dynos cost more.
scale_process_type.name: scale_process_type

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: The process type to scale, such as web or worker.
parameters.name: process_type

parameters.description: How many dynos to run. 0 stops the process type.
parameters.name: quantity

parameters.description: The dyno size, such as Eco, Basic, Standard-1X, Standard-2X, Performance-M or Performance-L. Leave blank to keep the current size.
parameters.name: size

set_config_vars.description: Add, change or remove an app's config vars. Heroku restarts the app's dynos to apply them. Answers with names only, never values.
set_config_vars.name: set_config_vars

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: Config vars to add or change: each name with its new value.
parameters.name: set

schema.description: Config vars to add or change: each name with its new value.

parameters.description: Names of config vars to remove.
parameters.name: remove

schema.description: Names of config vars to remove.

set_maintenance_mode.description: Turn an app's maintenance mode on, so visitors see a maintenance page, or off again.

set_maintenance_mode.display_str_template: Turn maintenance mode on or off.
set_maintenance_mode.name: set_maintenance_mode

parameters.description: The app, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app

parameters.description: On to show the maintenance page, off to serve the app again.
parameters.name: maintenance

set_maintenance_mode.result_str_template: Turn maintenance mode on or off completed.

description: Manage Heroku apps: restart and scale dynos, set config vars, roll back releases, and watch for new releases.

heroku_new_app_trigger.description: Runs for each new app in Heroku. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name, web_url, git_url, maintenance, acm, internal_routing, buildpack_provided_description, build_stack.id, build_stack.name, stack.id, stack.name, region.id, region.name, generation.id, generation.name, owner.id, owner.email, team.id, team.name, space.id, space.name, space.shield, repo_size, slug_size, archived_at, created_at, released_at, updated_at

heroku_new_release_trigger.description: Runs for each new release in Heroku. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, version, description, status, current, eligible_for_rollback, addon_plan_names, artifacts, slug.id, user.id, user.email, app.id, app.name, output_stream_url, created_at, updated_at

parameters.description: The app to watch, by name or ID.
parameters.name: app
